content.title: Contact Social Security | SSA
content.text: How can we help? (En español) You can use our online services to apply for benefits, check the status of your claim or appeal, request a replacement Social Security card (in many areas), get an instant benefit verification letter, and much more. View our full list of online services Our website, www.ssa.gov, is the best way to get help. If you cannot use our website, please call our National 800 Number or your local Social Security office. We can often help by phone and save you a trip to an office. If you need in-person help, you must make an appointment to visit a local office. Before You Consider Calling Frequently Asked Questions Did you know we’ve answered more than 200 of your most frequently asked questions (FAQs)? Check out the online FAQs for quick and convenient answers. Get answers Most Popular Questions How do I apply for a new or replacement Social Security number card?
